note: fields by ROLE only; values are discovered from the data by families_ext.discover (the fixed rank/percentile rules of queries.discover, plus geo extent and nested values)

skip_paths./_plugins/_ppl: PPL needs the opensearch-sql plugin, which is in neither the S0 nor the POC distribution; the workload's own DSL translation of the same queries (operations/dsl.json) is measured

body_edits.reason: removed identically in every arm: a cold query slower than the workload's 1m search timeout would return partial results, which can be neither compared nor timed; without the key the query runs to completion

families_not_applicable.text:match: no text field: every string field of the clickbench mapping is keyword
families_not_applicable.text:phrase: no text field: every string field of the clickbench mapping is keyword
families_not_applicable.text:query_string: no text field: every string field of the clickbench mapping is keyword
families_not_applicable.text:multi_match: no text field: every string field of the clickbench mapping is keyword

split_bkd.reason: the clickbench index has an index sort (CounterID, EventDate, UserID, EventTime, WatchID); PointsFormatSelectingCodec falls back to the stock points format on an index-sorted index (one WARN), so a split-BKD copy would hold stock-format files

single_shard.note: full corpus in 1 shard (the workload's own default layout)
